description: Stainless pipe rack: parallel S316 tube runs between two S316 support posts.
name: stainless_pipe_rack
why: 316 stainless resists chlorides and acids far better than plain STEL or RBAR thanks to its molybdenum alloying -- use this rack for coolant, brine, or acid-service pipe runs in marine or chemical-process cells where ordinary steel would corrode away. It still only melts around 1400 C, so it is not a substitute for reactor-grade STEL inside a high-flux core.
